Row 3: the ground explosion (bomb_explosion_animation_tbl 4944-4951: 60, 61, 64/68/6C 2x2, 62, 63, colour 0x0C). Explosion cells are 32x32 with every frame centred: each explosion nudges the object 8 px up-left as it enters a 2x2 frame (player 2056-2063, air 4872-4875, ground 4919-4923), which cancels half of the 2x2's right/down overhang (sprite_draw_double_width_and_height, amiga.68k 2529-2544), so a 1x1 frame sits centred and a 2x2 frame fills the cell. Row 5: the bank-1 bomb tiles 0x11C/0x11D/0x11E at colours 0x25-0x28 (2468-2488); the enemy bullet is tile 0x11E at those colours (4763; xevious_sub.68k 208-218) and reuses the last four cells.
